- Half-state read, not written: `needs-user-decision` and `pm:awaiting-maintainer` together; the second leaves in the ruling's stroke.
- Facets (the card's block, re-read): ① B widens one existing declaration (closed four-valued) and adds no key or gate; ② 26 teaching lines across 8 packages measured by #26184, two follow-up cards (#26178, #26179) filed only after the maintainer asked; ③ a missing or untrue line is refused at the seat's ACCEPT, loudly; ④ net zero lines, no script, no ledger.

Ruling: batch #404 item 1 · letter B · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-27T00:54Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). The maintainer answered batch #404 with 「同意」 — every seat letter. Brief 6430900353. Letter **B**: a PR owes a `Skills-docs:` line (four values: updated in this PR · owed, files listed · follow-up card #N · none, with the reason) when its `Metadata-protocol:` is `added`, `semantic` or `narrowed`, **and** when its `Clause-②:` carries `(narrowing)` whatever the protocol kind. The line is read at the seat's ACCEPT: missing or untrue refuses the landing. No script parses it, no gate is added (`clause2-line.mjs` keeps reading only its two lines). Not A (misses the D5 class #26184 measured) and not C (the gap regrows).

Workload of the chosen letter (card column): skills · 1 PR (Tier S, `.claude/**`) · four existing lines widened — `SKILL.md:313` (claim template), the ACCEPT checks, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` Definition of done, `references/review-checklist.md`. P4 is stale: #26155 closed and PR #26286 merged, so the PR rebases on `main` only. No back-fill; the eight #26184 Part A cards are the back-fill.

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act (`domain:skills`, p2, `area:devpath`); `pm:awaiting-maintainer` removed in the same stroke. `Ruling-ref:` names this comment. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

`domain:skills#2` (seat post #19287) · 2026-10-27T01:38Z · ⛔ Not a claim.

Letter **B** is carried by PR #26381 (`Part of #26184`, Tier S, `.claude/**` only): the four rule lines (os-dev.md Definition of done, SKILL.md claim template + ACCEPT checks, review-checklist.md, triage-duties.md) state the trigger as kind non-`none` OR a `(narrowing)` arm, which is this card's ruling 6431004737 and the same letter the maintainer tapped on the seat thread's decision card (2026-10-27T00:33Z). The PR's independent contract review (6431523599) returned FAIL on one lost clause (`updated here` must also mean the package's evals exercise it) and one spelling; the rework is on the same branch and is re-read on the new head before the seat lands it. This card closes by the seat's hand with that landing, which the landing record on #26184 will cite.
